rows.description: Rows written to the working dataset.

source.description: What was read: the lineage parent.

source_hash.description: sha256 of the local bytes read, when the source is a local file (the upstream export's registry id, #1432). Absent for any other source.

source_bytes.description: Size of the local bytes read.

quarantined_rows.description: Malformed source lines quarantined (#1008); the intake verdict reads it — any nonzero count is invalid_format (ADR-0102 D1, #2396).

snapshot_hash.description: sha256 of the working dataset as materialised, for every source: one Hub revision always gives the same value, a moved branch a new one. Not a lineage id.

revision.description: The Hub revision the source was loaded at; null for a source that is not a Hub id or when none was asked for.

revision_sha.description: The commit that revision resolved to, looked up after the load (best effort; null offline).
